name: UPA中世纪现代动画
palette: 奶油白、芥末黄、砖红、青绿与黑色，严格限制在三至五种平面色
lighting: 不使用写实体积光，阴影是简洁几何色块，背景保持高度概括
optics: 平面舞台式空间、不对称负形、细线人物与几何城市透视，拒绝三维镜头质感
composition: 人物、家具和建筑由少量线条与色块组织，留白积极参与节奏和叙事
camera_motion: graphic lateral pan, limited-animation hold, geometric wipe, rhythmic planar reframing
style_instructions: UPA-inspired mid-century modern limited animation, thin economical linework, flat geometric color fields, asymmetric negative space, simplified architecture and witty planar staging.
avoid_instructions: No anime cel highlights, no rounded 3D family-film volume, no corporate vector template, no paper-cut texture, no realistic gradients, no text or watermark.
